description: Minify or beautify CSS. Operations: "minify" — Minify CSS (strip comments and whitespace).; "beautify" — Beautify CSS (one declaration per line, indented).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: minify: The CSS to minify. beautify: The CSS to beautify.

operation.description: minify — Minify CSS (strip comments and whitespace). beautify — Beautify CSS (one declaration per line, indented).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: css-minify
title: CSS Minifier & Beautifier
